title: Inheriting Scenes: Editor wants to bundle export field packedScenes into .tscn instead of reference in 4.5 dev5
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducable in 4.5 dev5 but only for projects/scenes created in 4.5 dev4 or earlier

### System information

Windows 10 - v4.5.dev5.official [64b09905c]

### Issue description

Edit: when overriding an export field in the inheriting scene of a scene that already has a value set in the parent-scene, it will loose the connection to the packedScene resource in the inheriting scene when reopening the Inheriting scene.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/43b299bc-e0c4-4395-aa68-a1bcc5741f25

In certain constellations of scenes and inherited scenes, when opening a scene in 4.5 dev5 will instead of linking to the orignal scene, instead act as if its a bundled PackedScene in an export, and on saving bundle the scene into the .tscn.

The expected behaviour for me would be that it works just like in 4.5 dev 4 where this didnt happen and PackedScenes that got added to an export, would keep their link and not be bundled into the .tscn

This might have something to do with an inheriting scene having a value overriding the default defined by the parent-scene, but only affecting PackedScenes from what i see.

Here is how a falsely bundled packedscene would then look like in the scene file (from my personal project)

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/28bd264c-4b95-4f1e-a3cc-cb1d63c75211)

### Steps to reproduce

Create a project in Godot 4.5 dev4 or earlier and create 4 scenes:
For my example i did it in Godot 4.4

- Scene1: Parent-scene
- Scene2: A scene inheriting from the parent-scene

- PackedScene1:A scene acting as packedScene
- PackedScene2: A scene acting as packedScene

Scene1 gets a script with a `@export` of the type PackedScene.

Scene 1: add PackedScene1 to the export field via drag and drop
save Scene1
Scene2: add PackedScene2 to the export field via drag and drop
save Scene2
close Scene2
open Scene2

Now when opening the Scene_2 it will show the Export like this:(BAD)

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/92424102-5864-42d7-b426-1169f6d8c08d)
(Tooltip only says: "PackedScene")

In godot 4.5 dev4 it would look like this: (CORRECT)

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b0e84f51-977f-4f1f-ad2d-7aeb7d912bef)

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[4.5-dev-5-export-packedscene-becoming-bundled.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/20659501/4.5-dev-5-export-packedscene-becoming-bundled.zip)
